# Inonda LTD (inonda.org)

> Inonda LTD is a Cyprus contractor for property maintenance, repairs and home transformation: plumbing, electrical, air conditioning, waterproofing, kitchens, bathrooms and complete renovations in Nicosia and across Cyprus.

Registered company HE 490415, 29 Charalampou Mouskou, 2014 Strovolos, Nicosia, Cyprus. Email inonda2026@outlook.com.
Irina, Director: +357 94 091 616 (WhatsApp, Viber), Russian, Greek, English. Constantin, Secretary / Technician / Foreman: +357 94 091 613, Romanian, Greek, English.
We answer and quote in Greek, English, Russian and Romanian (website also in Ukrainian and Hebrew). Property management services: https://www.inonda.site/

## Services
- [Maintenance plans](https://www.inonda.org/en/maintenance-plans/): Scheduled servicing for homes, rentals, offices and buildings, with one point of contact and priority call-outs.
- [Air conditioning](https://www.inonda.org/en/air-conditioning-services/): Installation, servicing, deep cleaning, gas top-up and repair of split units, multi-splits and heat pumps.
- [Roof waterproofing & damp](https://www.inonda.org/en/roof-waterproofing-damp/): Flat roof and terrace waterproofing, insulation, leak tracing and lasting fixes for damp and mould.
- [Plumbing](https://www.inonda.org/en/plumbing-services/): Leaks, blockages, water heaters, pumps, pipework and bathroom and kitchen fittings, done by licensed plumbers.
- [Electrical works](https://www.inonda.org/en/electrical-services/): Fault finding, rewiring, panels, lighting, sockets and EV chargers, by licensed electricians with certificates.
- [Small repairs under maintenance contract](https://www.inonda.org/en/contract-repairs/): Maintenance-contract customers only. The to-do list: doors, locks, shelves, furniture assembly, silicone, curtain rails, TV mounting and more.
- [Urgent repairs under maintenance contract](https://www.inonda.org/en/emergency-repairs/): Maintenance-contract customers only. Burst pipes, leaks into neighbours, power failures, broken locks and storm damage, made safe fast.
- [Kitchen renovation](https://www.inonda.org/en/kitchen-renovation/): New kitchens designed and installed: cabinets, worktops, appliances, tiling, plumbing and lighting.
- [Bathroom renovation](https://www.inonda.org/en/bathroom-renovation/): Complete bathrooms: waterproofing, pipework, walk-in showers, tiling, vanities and lighting.
- [Complete home renovation](https://www.inonda.org/en/home-renovation/): Full refurbishments of apartments and houses: layouts, services, finishes, project-managed by one team.
- [Painting, plaster & gypsum](https://www.inonda.org/en/painting-plastering-gypsum/): Interior and exterior painting, plastering, gypsum board ceilings and partitions, decorative finishes.
- [Flooring & tiling](https://www.inonda.org/en/flooring-tiling/): Porcelain and ceramic tiling, large-format slabs, laminate, vinyl and wood floors, screeds and levelling.
- [Doors, windows & carpentry](https://www.inonda.org/en/doors-windows-carpentry/): Aluminium and PVC windows, interior doors, wardrobes, built-ins and repairs to shutters and frames.
- [Outdoor works](https://www.inonda.org/en/outdoor-works/): Pergolas, paving, terraces, fencing, garden walls, outdoor lighting and irrigation.
- [Aluminium works](https://www.inonda.org/en/aluminium-works/): Thermal-break windows, sliding doors, roller shutters, veranda enclosures, pergolas and railings in aluminium.
- [HPL cladding](https://www.inonda.org/en/hpl-cladding/): HPL wall panelling, ventilated HPL facades and compact HPL partitions for homes and businesses.
- [Decorative panels](https://www.inonda.org/en/decorative-panels/): PVC marble-effect sheets, WPC and fluted panels, acoustic slat walls and 3D decorative panels.
